The two-dimensional Ky Fan comparison follows from the exact real 2x2 R_plus/R_minus singular-value expressions and nonnegative spectral divided differences. Expanding two Frobenius norms by cyclic trace and powers affine in P,Q cancels every term but the four-projection difference, exactly half the squared projection commutator norm; substituting spectral gaps gives the identity, including scalar/equality boundaries. Rational verifier: 486 exact identities, 972 finite Ky Fan tests; independent random complex tests: 840. Numerical tests are supplemental, not proof.
